moat_source: switching costs and government accreditation (deep workflow integration, security clearances); evidence: 85% y/y growth with ~54% FCF margin implies pricing power today, but hyperscaler/foundation-model competition caps the moat rating

returns.assumption_note: Convergence to scenario IV by year 5, ~60% of the gap closed by year 3.

primary_model_risk: Terminal multiple: +/-2 turns on year-5 FCF moves base-case IV by roughly +/-15%, more than any operating assumption; the valuation is a bet on what the market will pay for decelerated growth in 2031.
expectations_gap_key_variable: duration of hypergrowth: at $133.36 the price embeds roughly 45%+ compound revenue growth for 5 years at ~50% FCF margins with a 35x+ exit multiple; base case assumes deceleration to the low-20s by 2030
top_5_bull_arguments: Raised FY2026 guidance to $7.65-7.662B revenue (+71% y/y) with US commercial guided +120% - execution is not the question
$4.2-4.4B adjusted FCF guidance at ~55% margin funds everything internally; balance sheet risk is negligible
Nvidia sovereign-AI partnership and Army NGC2 award deepen the government accreditation moat
US commercial +133% y/y shows the AIP land-and-expand motion is working beyond government
If hypergrowth persists longer than modeled (bull case), 40x on ~$17B year-5 FCF yields ~$190/share
top_5_bear_arguments: At ~145x trailing earnings and ~33x forward sales, even the base case (deceleration to +22% by 2030) produces a negative expected return from $133.36
Foundation-model vendors and hyperscalers are attacking AIP differentiation; competitive risk rated High
UK NHS contract (~$440M) non-renewal would be the first visible crack in the government franchise
Stock fell ~27-30% earlier in 2026 on deceleration fears alone - beta 2.10 cuts both ways
Expected intrinsic value ($117.7) sits below the current price; the July rally re-opened the gap the drawdown had closed
thesis_breakers: Any quarter with US commercial revenue growth below ~60% y/y (guidance implies 120%)
Adjusted FCF margin falling below 45% for two consecutive quarters
Loss of a flagship US government program (NGC2 descoped or recompeted away)
NHS non-renewal followed by a second sovereign contract loss (pattern, not one-off)
position_size_recommendation: 0-1% (watchlist; buy zone begins below ~$106, a 10% discount to expected IV)
notes_on_nulls: ROIC/ROE/ROA are null: the deterministic pass1 snapshot does not carry balance-sheet or income-statement detail and no sourced figures for these ratios were captured in claude_pass1; inventing them would violate the ground-truth constraint. Valuation rests on guided revenue/FCF (8-K sourced) rather than a full three-statement model - confidence_level medium reflects that.
historical_context: Directional context only - low confidence. No verified 5-year historical multiple range was captured in pass1/claude_pass1; terminal multiples are justified against business quality and growth durability rather than the company's own trading history. The only verified historical datapoints: the stock fell ~27-30% earlier in 2026 and has a 52-week range of $106.37-$207.52 (pass1 web quotes).
